# City of Plano, TX

> Official municipal government portal for Plano, Texas providing comprehensive city services, resident resources, business information, and civic engagement opportunities.

Plano's official website serves as the central hub for municipal services, government information, and community resources. The site is built on the CivicPlus platform and provides integrated access to utilities, permits, parks, library services, and citizen programs.

## Key Topics

- City Services
- Municipal Government
- Parks and Recreation
- Animal Services
- Business Permits and Zoning
- Utilities and Billing
- Public Library
- Civic Engagement
- Resident Resources
- Government Structure
- City Events
- Police Services
- Water Resources
- Volunteer Programs
- Environmental Services

## Core Services

- [City Services](https://www.plano.gov/2305/City-Services): Directory of municipal services including utilities, permits, and animal services
- [Government](https://www.plano.gov/27/Government): Government structure, elected officials, boards, commissions, and records

## Resident Resources

- [Living Here](https://www.plano.gov/31/Living-Here): Resident resources including checklists, guides, and community information
- [Explore Plano](https://www.plano.gov/101/Explore-Plano): Visitor and resident guide covering attractions, parks, and local information

## Business Development

- [Doing Business](https://www.plano.gov/35/Doing-Business): Business resources covering permits, zoning, licensing, and development

## Community Engagement

- [Citizen Programs](https://www.plano.gov/1102/Citizen-Programs): Volunteer opportunities and citizen programs including police community initiatives

## Optional Resources

- [Household Chemicals](https://www.plano.gov/958/Household-Chemicals): Guidelines for household chemical disposal and reuse in Plano
